description: [roadmap S2.11] The bulletin board's photos are not drawn: for each dated record of g_bulletinEvents showBulletinBoard loads a snapshot BMP (loadBmpSurface of the name built from f_strpool_4e3e7c + the record index + f_strpool_4c4970 + 0x4d0) that narrateShot wrote with saveBmp from the screen (a capture of the course), and blits it with Surface_blitThunk at (x, y - 0xa6), 0xc8 x 0xa0. description: [roadmap S2.11] The message ball's head is not drawn: drawThoughtBubble(sel, x, y, -1) draws Surface_drawScaled of the head g_sprites5628e8 + 0x2c * (3 * (app + 72 * typeBit7Clear(sel)) + thoughtFlag(sel)) at the ball's origin; the heads are cut by loadInterfaceArt's IaHeads steps and by the theme / character portraits (loadThemeFile), the drawing body and the cuts are roadmap S3.6's (gfx_hud.cpp in the working tree) and the colours follow composeGolferSprite's palette layers (S3.5).
